title: 숲 가장자리의 대공 경계
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. AsteraCraft widescreen 16:9 loading artwork, no text or UI.
Create a NEW warm daylight scene matching the natural moss-green, orange and soft gold forest atmosphere and physical realism of the LAST reference. Preserve its wet natural peel, leaves, bronze, restrained light and atmospheric depth, but use a completely different side-on shoreline composition. Do NOT recreate a dark blue night scene, moon or bare snowy mountain.
Story: one existing Citrus thorn-flower guards a forest lakeshore from a distant enemy owl delta fighter. The thorn-flower stands in the LEFT foreground beside leafy ferns, side/front three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Its actual short cannon fires a few very small thin thorns UPWARD across the lake toward the distant fighter, showing active anti-air defense.
Identity from image1: narrow dark bronze chassis with SIX elongated pointed orange petal-shaped lobes in a radial flower fan, natural attached green leaves between them, slender green leaf/root legs, ONE slim cyan-tipped antenna and ONE short existing forward cannon. NOT a swollen bunch of round oranges or a healer, no new weapon. The single actual enemy delta fighter matches image2: flat ivory triangular delta wing, red wing panels, gold beak nose, black canopy.
CRITICAL PERSPECTIVE: a single coherent 50mm eye-level camera, 1.2m above the path. The 1.3m-tall thorn-flower is about 5m from camera and occupies about 35% of frame height. The 8m-wide fighter is 300 METERS AWAY across the lake, just above distant treetops and no more than SIX PERCENT of frame width; it must look SMALL and recede naturally into atmospheric haze, NOT hover giant next to the defender and NOT pasted onto sky. Sun, shadows, haze and focus follow the same physical scene. The aircraft is an incident in the landscape, not a second giant foreground object.
Composition: bright forest border on LEFT, sunlit mossy path curving from lower left to open lake on RIGHT, distant wooded ridge and a little pale sky across upper half. The thorn-flower's petal silhouette, leaf legs and short cannon clearly visible above low ferns. Small splashes of light on leaves and bronze, soft midday sun through woodland, real humidity and a continuous believable terrain. No worker, crystal mining, close overhead root, or same central fruit creature composition as the earlier pair. Camera nearly horizontal, no isometric view, no plastic figurines, neon, line-up, giant projectiles or alien unit designs. Exactly one actual thorn-flower and one very distant actual fighter.
